use_case: AI quality inspection on processing lines: cameras and edge inference on Plant 1 Lines 5-7 inspect sliced and packaged products for foreign material, seal defects, and label and lot-code errors, and divert suspect packs
business_owner: Vice President of Food Safety and Quality Assurance (operated by the Plant 1 FSQA Manager)
vendor_or_model: AI vision inspection vendor (vendor-trained vision models on edge servers; retraining in the vendor cloud)
data_categories: Product and label images; lot codes from the MES; incidental images of workers' hands and arms
human_in_the_loop: AI-001 only diverts packs; QA technicians decide every diverted pack; x-ray and metal detection remain the foreign material CCP; manual visual inspection unchanged; operators can switch to bypass
applicable_laws: 9 CFR 417.4(a)(3) (reassessment if it changes the process or monitoring); 9 CFR 418.2 (misbranding or adulteration that reaches commerce); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor accuracy claims)
status: In production (Plant 1 Lines 5-7 since 2025-09); Plant 2 pilot on hold until conditions are met

use_case: ERP demand forecasting: machine learning forecasts of weekly demand by product and customer, used for production plans and raw material purchasing
data_categories: Sales history, promotions calendar, customer orders (no personal information)
human_in_the_loop: Planners review and can override every forecast before the production plan is published
applicable_laws: None specific; contract terms with the ERP vendor

use_case: Refrigeration predictive maintenance analytics: vendor model scores compressor and evaporator health from outbound telemetry and recommends maintenance
vendor_or_model: Refrigeration analytics vendor (vendor model; telemetry sent outbound from the Plant 1 OT DMZ broker)
data_categories: Compressor vibration, temperature, pressure, and run-time data
consequential_decision_category: None (advisory; re-tier to Safety/CI if used to change PSM inspection intervals)
human_in_the_loop: Recommendations only; the PSM mechanical integrity schedule and the refrigeration technicians decide all work
applicable_laws: 29 CFR 1910.119(j)(4)(iii) and 40 CFR 68.73(d)(3) (inspection frequency must follow manufacturer recommendations and good engineering practice; the model cannot replace that basis); 1910.119(l) (management of change for the telemetry path)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for office staff (drafting, summarizing, spreadsheet help) under enterprise data-use terms
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI assistant (large language model; vendor-hosted; no training on company data by contract)
data_categories: Internal documents up to Confidential; Restricted data prohibited (formulations, food defense plans, employee personal information, credentials)
human_in_the_loop: Users review all output; no automated actions or integrations
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (if employee personal information were entered, which POL-04 4.8 and POL-05 4.7 prohibit)

use_case: Applicant ranking feature in the HR SaaS: scores and ranks applicants for hourly production jobs against job requirements
vendor_or_model: HR SaaS vendor (vendor model, enabled by default in a 2026-04 release)
data_categories: Applicant resumes, application answers, work history
human_in_the_loop: Feature disabled 2026-08-20; if ever re-enabled, recruiters must review every applicant regardless of score and the score may not screen anyone out
applicable_laws: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act (disparate impact, 42 U.S.C. 2000e-2(k)); Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures (29 CFR 1607.4(D) four-fifths rule as the adverse impact measure)
status: Retired (disabled 2026-08-20; not to be re-enabled without a new assessment)
